sources.entry: WSUP AI - Free AI character chat in the browser — talk to AI characters with no sign up. SFW only. #free

summary.name: WSUP AI
summary.one_liner: WSUP AI is a free browser-based site for chatting with user-made AI characters in categories such as anime, romance, roleplay, and fan characters, with no sign-up required.
use_cases: chat with fictional or anime characters
try out AI companion chat without an account
summary.what_it_does: The page is a catalogue of AI characters that users can open and chat with in the browser. Characters are grouped into categories including Anime, Companion, K-Wave, Modern, Roleplay, Romance, Misc, and Fan / Unofficial, with lists such as popular now, best conversation starters, best-rated chats, and new characters. Each listing shows a character count and per-character stats such as chatter counts, ratings, or percentages of replies. An "Unfiltered" toggle hides or shows explicit characters. The page advertises free chat with no sign-up required.
notable: No sign-up needed to start chatting, per the page
Large library of about 2,192 user-listed characters across several categories
Unfiltered toggle controls whether explicit characters are shown
Listed as SFW-only in the hanishrao/collective-ai-tools directory
caveats: Listing describes the tool as SFW only, but the page itself shows an Unfiltered toggle and some explicit-sounding character names, so content filtering may be inconsistent
Character content is user-generated and varies in quality and appropriateness
